item.title: No eradication method for highly invasive species in Lough Erne
item.description: There is no eradication method available to remove highly invasive quagga mussels from Lower Lough Erne, the Environment Minister Andrew Muir has said.

item.title: Over 500 Invest NI-supported jobs already created in Fermanagh and South Tyrone
item.description: More than 500 of the jobs supported by Invest NI in Fermanagh and South Tyrone over the past five years have already been created, Economy Minister Caoimhe Archibald has said.

item.title: Artists unite in Enniskillen for mental health charity gig
item.description: Artists from the worlds of music, poetry and spoken word will unite on Saturday, February 21, for a very special charity gig in support of mental health.

item.title: Former owner of Cavan hotel that was county's 'go-to place' dies
item.description: Tributes have been paid to a former hotelier in County Cavan who died earlier this week.

item.title: Public rally to be held this weekend as future of SWAH general surgery still unknown
item.description: The future of emergency general surgery and wider health services in Fermanagh and West Tyrone remains unresolved, with campaign group Save Our Acute Services (SOAS) to host a public rally on Sunday.

item.title: Jane builds engineering career through higher level apprenticeship route
item.description: As part of NI Apprenticeship Week (February 2 to February 6), South West College (SWC) is highlighting the transformative impact of apprenticeships and the powerful opportunities created through strong local education and industry partnerships.

item.title: 'It is a lifeline' - Irish government warned as fears grow over 'cancer flights'
